'''Citros snow cake''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] enjoyed by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. It was made with a sweet cake mix, and included 10 units of wild [[Wheat/Legends|wheat]], 20 pieces of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]], and a food additive.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
